title: Potato Bludgeon
description: A mod adding an item, a recipe and an advancement. The Potato Bludgeon.
body:
This mod adds a weapon called "The Potato Bludgeon" which deals 10 hearts of damage and can be crafted with a mace, blaze powder and a poisounus potato in a smithing table. It has the same attack speed as a sword. It also sets the attacked mob on fire for 15 seconds, providing that the mob takes fire damage - for instance it does not set a warden on fire.

No further updates planned.

You may use this mod in your modpack as long as you provide a clickable link to it in the description.
